title: No transient-nuclear test matches after 17 March 1956

tellings.quote: uh the last time we saw a correspondence between a nuclear test and a uh transient was March 17th, 1956.

plain: Old sky photographs from Palomar Observatory show "transients", brief points of light that appear and then vanish, and some are said to line up in time with nuclear tests, but the last such match is said to fall on 17 March 1956. A guest named Steven Bruel says this on an episode with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, without naming a source: "the last time we saw a correspondence between a nuclear test and a transient was March 17th, 1956." The point matters because if the lights tracked nuclear tests, their stopping would say something about what they were.
